candidates.hypothesis_boundary: Enter continuation only from confirmed rising swing-high and swing-low structure; invalidate on structural higher-low failure.
candidates.dedupe_boundary: Price-structure continuation, not moving-average trend following and not channel breakout.
candidates.lookahead_guard: Swing points must be confirmed using data available at the decision timestamp; no future-bar relabeling.

candidates.hypothesis_boundary: Use RSI as a continuation/burst threshold, never as an oversold mean-reversion entry.
candidates.dedupe_boundary: No price-channel breakout and no ATR-sized directional-candle trigger; distinct from roc_breakout_confirm_v1 and momentum_capture_v1.
candidates.lookahead_guard: RSI must use closed candles only.

candidates.hypothesis_boundary: Filter-only overlay that blocks entries during chaotic high volatility; it does not generate an alpha entry.
candidates.dedupe_boundary: Measures activity compression and avoided friction, not volatility breakout or ATR expansion alpha.
candidates.lookahead_guard: Volatility state must be computed from closed candles only.

candidates.hypothesis_boundary: Fade confirmed structural range edges and exit at the range midpoint or structural invalidation.
candidates.dedupe_boundary: Support/resistance geometry only; no rolling z-score and no Bollinger-band normalized-distance trigger.
candidates.lookahead_guard: Range edges must be confirmed without future bars and frozen for each decision.

candidates.hypothesis_boundary: A direction from the last completed derived 5m bar gates a separately specified 1m entry trigger.
candidates.dedupe_boundary: Exactly one 5m bias layer plus 1m trigger; no 15m hierarchy and no generic htf_bias_ltf_trigger_v1.
candidates.lookahead_guard: At a 1m decision timestamp, only fully closed 5m aggregates may be consumed.

dedupe_resolutions.rationale: Bollinger normalized distance is materially equivalent to rolling mean/standard-deviation z-score logic already screened in Batch A.
The lower-complexity rank-5 1m+5m candidate occupies the MTF lane; 5m/15m hierarchy is deferred until it can justify incremental information.
